title: Portfolio Update
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

claims.reason: The fund structure targets curve and volatility exposure, so the intended mechanism is coherent. Replacing bills also adds TIPS duration, option costs and basis risk. A favorable curve move does not guarantee a positive total return.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

evidence.title: IVOL statutory prospectus
evidence.finding: Fund combines TIPS exposure with options tied to interest-rate curve and volatility; total return can differ from any one factor. A steepening benefit is conditional and does not make the fund equivalent to cash.
